```{r expansionProportionPlotsTconvsClusterFacetDonorCellsInStimDenom_noPolyclonal_REMOVED}
# expansionProportionPlotsTconvsClusterFacetDonorCellsInStimDenom_noPolyclonal
# Create a temporary TCR dataframe so that we don't bother the original
cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df

# Create a clone ID in the TCR dataframe
cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  mutate(cloneID = paste(fullLengthNTa, fullLengthNTb, sep = "_"))

# Count how many cells per cloneID within each stimulation
clone_counts <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  group_by(stimulationFigures, cloneID) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Mark expanded clones (more than 1 cell within the same stimulation)
expanded_clones <- clone_counts %>%
  filter(n_cells > 1) %>%
  mutate(stim_clone = paste(stimulationFigures, cloneID, sep = "_")) %>%
  pull(stim_clone)

# Annotate each cell as expanded or not (within stimulation)
cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  mutate(stim_clone = paste(stimulationFigures, cloneID, sep = "_"),
    expanded = stim_clone %in% expanded_clones)

# Add expansion info to Seurat metadata
metadata_Tconv <- seuratQCMergedCleaned@meta.data %>%
  filter(cellType == "Tconv") %>%
  mutate(barcode = rownames(.))

# Merge with TCR info
metadata_Tconv <- metadata_Tconv %>%
  left_join(cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>% select(barcode, expanded), by = "barcode") %>%
  mutate(expanded = ifelse(is.na(expanded), FALSE, expanded))

# ---- Filter to only IAR and Microbial ----
metadata_Tconv <- metadata_Tconv %>%
  filter(stimulationFigures %in% c("IAR", "Microbial"))

# ---- Preserve zeroes ----
# Get all possible combinations of donor, stimulation, and cluster
all_donors <- unique(metadata_Tconv$donorIdFigures)
all_stims <- c("IAR", "Microbial")
all_clusters <- unique(metadata_Tconv$seurat_clusters_Tconv)

complete_framework <- expand.grid(
  donorIdFigures = all_donors,
  stimulationFigures = all_stims,
  seurat_clusters_Tconv = all_clusters,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Calculate total Tconv cells per donor+stimulation+cluster
total_Tconv_per_group <- metadata_Tconv %>%
  group_by(donorIdFigures, stimulationFigures, seurat_clusters_Tconv) %>%
  summarise(total_Tconv = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Calculate expanded cells per group (including zeros)
expanded_counts_raw <- metadata_Tconv %>%
  filter(expanded) %>%
  group_by(donorIdFigures, stimulationFigures, seurat_clusters_Tconv) %>%
  summarise(n_expanded = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Merge, preserving zeros
expanded_counts <- complete_framework %>%
  left_join(total_Tconv_per_group, by = c("donorIdFigures", "stimulationFigures", "seurat_clusters_Tconv")) %>%
  left_join(expanded_counts_raw, by = c("donorIdFigures", "stimulationFigures", "seurat_clusters_Tconv")) %>%
  mutate(
    total_Tconv = ifelse(is.na(total_Tconv), 0, total_Tconv),
    n_expanded = ifelse(is.na(n_expanded), 0, n_expanded),
    prop_expanded = ifelse(total_Tconv == 0, 0, n_expanded / total_Tconv * 100)
  ) %>%
  # Only keep combinations where there are actually cells for that donor/cluster
  filter(total_Tconv > 0)

# ---- Paired t-test with logit transformation ----
# Calculate statistics for each cluster separately
cluster_stats <- expanded_counts %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters_Tconv) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(~ {
    cluster_data <- .x
    cluster_name <- unique(cluster_data$seurat_clusters_Tconv)

    # Get data for each stimulation
    iar_data <- filter(cluster_data, stimulationFigures == "IAR")
    mic_data <- filter(cluster_data, stimulationFigures == "Microbial")

    # Find donors present in both conditions
    paired_donors <- intersect(iar_data$donorIdFigures, mic_data$donorIdFigures)
    n_paired <- length(paired_donors)

    # Calculate p-value if we have enough paired observations
    if (n_paired >= 3) {
      # Get paired data
      iar_paired <- iar_data %>%
        filter(donorIdFigures %in% paired_donors) %>%
        arrange(donorIdFigures) %>%
        pull(prop_expanded)

      mic_paired <- mic_data %>%
        filter(donorIdFigures %in% paired_donors) %>%
        arrange(donorIdFigures) %>%
        pull(prop_expanded)

      # Apply logit transformation (add small constant to handle 0s and 100s)
      iar_props <- pmax(pmin(iar_paired, 99.99), 0.01) / 100
      mic_props <- pmax(pmin(mic_paired, 99.99), 0.01) / 100

      iar_logit <- logit(iar_props)
      mic_logit <- logit(mic_props)

      # Paired t-test on logit-transformed values
      test <- try(t.test(iar_logit, mic_logit, paired = TRUE), silent = TRUE)
      p_val <- if (inherits(test, "try-error")) NA_real_ else test$p.value
    } else {
      p_val <- NA_real_
    }

    data.frame(
      seurat_clusters_Tconv = cluster_name,
      n_paired = n_paired,
      p_val = p_val
    )
  })

p_values <- cluster_stats %>%
  mutate(
    adj_p = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"),
    label = ifelse(is.na(adj_p), paste0("n=", n_paired, " (insufficient)"),
      paste0("p_adj = ", signif(adj_p, 3)))
  ) # Annotation y-position
annotation_df <- expanded_counts %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters_Tconv) %>%
  summarise(ann_y = max(prop_expanded, na.rm = TRUE) + 5, .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(p_values, by = "seurat_clusters_Tconv")

plot.tmp <- ggplot(expanded_counts, aes(x = stimulationFigures, y = prop_expanded)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = stimulationFigures), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(color = "black", width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggh4x::facet_wrap2(
    ~seurat_clusters_Tconv, nrow = 1,
    strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
      background_x = setNames(
        lapply(palRNAClustersTconv, function(clr) element_rect(fill = clr)),
        names(palRNAClustersTconv)
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Stimulation",
    y = "Percentage of expanded Tconv cells per donor (within cluster)",
    title = "Per-donor Breakdown of Expanded Tconv Cells\nacross Stimulation and Clusters"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Stimulation", values = palStimulation) +
  geom_text(
    data = annotation_df,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = ann_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 3
  )

# Save the plot
# png(file.path(plotDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "TconvClusterBreakdown_PerStim_PercentExpanded_clusterColors_donorInStimDenom_IARvsMicrobial.png")),
#   height = 5.5, width = 8, units = "in", res = 600)
# print(plot.tmp)
# dev.off()

savePlot(
  plot = plot.tmp,
  plotDir = plotDir,
  filename = paste0("TconvClusterBreakdown_PerStim_PercentExpanded_clusterColors_donorInStimDenom_IARvsMicrobial"),
  height = 5.5,
  width = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  formats = c("pdf", "png") # or "pdf", "png", or c("pdf", "png")
)
```

```{r TCRStatisticsIntraStimulationOnly}
# across-3 Chi-Squared test
# version where we only consider within-stimulation sharing
cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df

# Calculate expansion within each stimulation group separately
expansion_summary <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  group_by(stimulationFigures) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Within this stimulation group, identify expanded pairs
    .x %>%
      mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))
  }) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pairs = n(),
    expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
    unique_pairs = total_pairs - expanded_pairs,
    expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== Within-Stimulation TCR Expansion Summary ===\n")
print(expansion_summary)

# Create contingency table for chi-square test
contingency_table <- expansion_summary %>%
  mutate(non_expanded_pairs = total_pairs - expanded_pairs) %>%
  select(stimulationFigures, expanded_pairs, non_expanded_pairs) %>%
  column_to_rownames("stimulationFigures") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("\n=== Contingency Table ===\n")
cat("Rows: Stimulation conditions\n")
cat("Columns: [Expanded pairs, Non-expanded pairs]\n")
print(contingency_table)

# Perform chi-square test
chi_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)

cat("\n=== Chi-Square Test Results ===\n")
cat("Testing: Are TCR expansion rates significantly different between stimulation conditions?\n")
cat("Chi-square statistic:", chi_test$statistic, "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", chi_test$parameter, "\n")
cat("P-value:", chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")

# Check assumptions
cat("\n=== Test Assumptions ===\n")
expected_counts <- chi_test$expected
min_expected <- min(expected_counts)
cat("Minimum expected count:", min_expected, "\n")
cat("All expected counts ≥ 5:", ifelse(min_expected >= 5, "YES (assumption met)", "NO (assumption violated)"), "\n")

if (min_expected < 5) {
  cat("WARNING: Chi-square assumptions may be violated. Consider Fisher's exact test.\n")

  # Perform Fisher's exact test as alternative
  fisher_test <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
  cat("\n=== Fisher's Exact Test (Alternative) ===\n")
  cat("P-value:", fisher_test$p.value, "\n")
  cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(fisher_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")
}

# Post-hoc analysis if significant
if (chi_test$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("\n=== Post-hoc Pairwise Comparisons ===\n")

  stimulations <- rownames(contingency_table)
  pairwise_p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(stimulations), ncol = length(stimulations),
    dimnames = list(stimulations, stimulations))

  for (i in 1:(length(stimulations) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(stimulations)) {
      pair_table <- contingency_table[c(i, j), ]
      pair_test <- fisher.test(pair_table)
      pairwise_p_values[i, j] <- pair_test$p.value
      pairwise_p_values[j, i] <- pair_test$p.value

      cat(stimulations[i], "vs", stimulations[j], "- p-value:",
        round(pair_test$p.value, 4),
        ifelse(pair_test$p.value < 0.05 / 3, "(significant after Bonferroni)", "(not significant)"), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# ==========================================Downsampling Function=======================================================
# Function for iterative downsampling with convergence detection
perform_downsampling_analysis <- function(tcr_data, target_sample_size, section_name = "Analysis",
                                          convergence_tolerance = 0.1, max_iterations = 10000,
                                          convergence_window = 20) {

  cat("\n=== ", section_name, " ===\n")
  cat("Target sample size per group:", target_sample_size, "\n")
  cat("Convergence tolerance: running average stable to", convergence_tolerance, "% (first decimal)\n")
  cat("Maximum iterations:", max_iterations, "\n\n")

  # Initialize tracking variables
  iteration_results <- data.frame()
  microbial_converged <- FALSE
  polyclonal_converged <- FALSE
  microbial_rates <- c()
  polyclonal_rates <- c()
  iteration <- 0

  # Get original expansion rates for reference
  expansion_summary_func <- tcr_data %>%
    group_by(stimulationFigures) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      .x %>%
        mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))
    }) %>%
    group_by(stimulationFigures) %>%
    summarise(
      total_pairs = n(),
      expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
      expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  cat("Original expansion rates (before downsampling):\n")
  print(expansion_summary_func)

  cat("\nStarting convergence analysis...\n")
  cat("Target: Stable cumulative average expansion rate (±", convergence_tolerance, "%) over", convergence_window, "iterations\n\n")

  # Main convergence loop with serial processing
  while ((!microbial_converged || !polyclonal_converged) && iteration < max_iterations) {
    iteration <- iteration + 1
    set.seed(iteration + 42)  # Reproducible but different seeds for each iteration

    # Only downsample Microbial if not yet converged
    if (!microbial_converged) {
      # Downsample Microbial group to target size
      microbial_data <- tcr_data %>%
        filter(stimulationFigures == "Microbial")

      if (nrow(microbial_data) > target_sample_size) {
        microbial_downsampled <- microbial_data %>%
          slice_sample(n = target_sample_size)
      } else {
        microbial_downsampled <- microbial_data
      }

      # Calculate expansion for this iteration
      microbial_expansion <- microbial_downsampled %>%
        mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0)) %>%
        summarise(
          total_pairs = n(),
          expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
          expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      # Add to cumulative rates
      microbial_rates <- c(microbial_rates, microbial_expansion$expansion_rate * 100)

      # Check convergence: running average stable to first decimal place for consecutive iterations
      if (length(microbial_rates) >= convergence_window) {
        # Calculate running averages for last convergence_window iterations
        recent_running_avgs <- sapply((length(microbial_rates) - convergence_window + 1):length(microbial_rates),
          function(i) mean(microbial_rates[1:i]))

        # Round to first decimal place and check if all are the same
        rounded_avgs <- round(recent_running_avgs, 1)

        if (length(unique(rounded_avgs)) == 1) {
          microbial_converged <- TRUE
          cat("✓ MICROBIAL CONVERGED at iteration", iteration, "\n")
          cat("  Running average stabilized at:", round(mean(microbial_rates), 1), "%\n")
          cat("  Last", convergence_window, "running averages:", paste(round(recent_running_avgs, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        }
      }
    }

    # Only downsample Polyclonal if not yet converged
    if (!polyclonal_converged) {
      # Downsample Polyclonal group to target size
      polyclonal_data <- tcr_data %>%
        filter(stimulationFigures == "Polyclonal")

      if (nrow(polyclonal_data) > target_sample_size) {
        polyclonal_downsampled <- polyclonal_data %>%
          slice_sample(n = target_sample_size)
      } else {
        polyclonal_downsampled <- polyclonal_data
      }

      # Calculate expansion for this iteration
      polyclonal_expansion <- polyclonal_downsampled %>%
        mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0)) %>%
        summarise(
          total_pairs = n(),
          expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
          expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      # Add to cumulative rates
      polyclonal_rates <- c(polyclonal_rates, polyclonal_expansion$expansion_rate * 100)

      # Check convergence: running average stable to first decimal place for consecutive iterations
      if (length(polyclonal_rates) >= convergence_window) {
        # Calculate running averages for last convergence_window iterations
        recent_running_avgs <- sapply((length(polyclonal_rates) - convergence_window + 1):length(polyclonal_rates),
          function(i) mean(polyclonal_rates[1:i]))

        # Round to first decimal place and check if all are the same
        rounded_avgs <- round(recent_running_avgs, 1)

        if (length(unique(rounded_avgs)) == 1) {
          polyclonal_converged <- TRUE
          cat("✓ POLYCLONAL CONVERGED at iteration", iteration, "\n")
          cat("  Running average stabilized at:", round(mean(polyclonal_rates), 1), "%\n")
          cat("  Last", convergence_window, "running averages:", paste(round(recent_running_avgs, 2), collapse = ", "), "\n")
        }
      }
    }

    # Store results for tracking
    current_microbial_avg <- if (length(microbial_rates) > 0) mean(microbial_rates) else NA
    current_polyclonal_avg <- if (length(polyclonal_rates) > 0) mean(polyclonal_rates) else NA

    iteration_results <- rbind(iteration_results, data.frame(
      iteration = iteration,
      microbial_rate = current_microbial_avg,
      iar_rate = expansion_summary_func$expansion_rate[expansion_summary_func$stimulationFigures == "IAR"] * 100,
      polyclonal_rate = current_polyclonal_avg,
      microbial_converged = microbial_converged,
      polyclonal_converged = polyclonal_converged
    ))

    # Print progress every 50 iterations
    if (iteration %% 50 == 0) {
      cat("Iteration", iteration)
      if (!microbial_converged) cat(" - Microbial avg:", round(current_microbial_avg, 1), "%")
      if (!polyclonal_converged) cat(" - Polyclonal avg:", round(current_polyclonal_avg, 1), "%")
      cat("\n")
    }
  }

  # Check if we hit max iterations without full convergence
  if (iteration >= max_iterations && (!microbial_converged || !polyclonal_converged)) {
    cat("⚠ Did not converge after", max_iterations, "iterations\n")
    if (!microbial_converged) cat("  Microbial did not converge\n")
    if (!polyclonal_converged) cat("  Polyclonal did not converge\n")
    cat("Using results from final iteration\n")
  }

  # Final results using cumulative averages
  final_microbial_rate <- mean(microbial_rates)
  final_polyclonal_rate <- mean(polyclonal_rates)
  final_iar_rate <- expansion_summary_func$expansion_rate[expansion_summary_func$stimulationFigures == "IAR"] * 100

  cat("\n=== Final ", section_name, " Results (Cumulative Averages) ===\n")
  cat("Iterations run:", iteration, "\n")
  cat("Final rates by stimulation:\n")
  cat("  Microbial:", round(final_microbial_rate, 1), "%\n")
  cat("  IAR:", round(final_iar_rate, 1), "% (unchanged)\n")
  cat("  Polyclonal:", round(final_polyclonal_rate, 1), "%\n\n")

  # Return results for further use
  return(list(
    microbial_rate = final_microbial_rate,
    iar_rate = final_iar_rate,
    polyclonal_rate = final_polyclonal_rate,
    iteration_results = iteration_results,
    iterations_run = iteration,
    microbial_rates = microbial_rates,
    polyclonal_rates = polyclonal_rates
  ))
}

# ==========================================Downsampled Analysis with Convergence=======================================================
# Get IAR cell count for combined analysis to determine target sample size
iar_count <- sum(cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp$stimulationFigures == "IAR")
cat("IAR cell count (combined):", iar_count, "\n")

# Use the downsampling function for the main analysis
main_results <- perform_downsampling_analysis(
  tcr_data = cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp,
  target_sample_size = iar_count,
  section_name = "Downsampled Analysis (Microbial and Polyclonal to match IAR)",
  convergence_tolerance = 0.1,
  max_iterations = 10000,
  convergence_window = 20
)

# Create final downsampled data from function results for statistical tests
set.seed(main_results$iterations_run + 42)
microbial_data <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  filter(stimulationFigures == "Microbial")
microbial_downsampled <- if (nrow(microbial_data) > iar_count) {
  microbial_data %>% slice_sample(n = iar_count)
} else {
  microbial_data
}

set.seed(main_results$iterations_run + 142)
polyclonal_data <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>%
  filter(stimulationFigures == "Polyclonal")
polyclonal_downsampled <- if (nrow(polyclonal_data) > iar_count) {
  polyclonal_data %>% slice_sample(n = iar_count)
} else {
  polyclonal_data
}

final_downsampled_data <- bind_rows(
  microbial_downsampled,
  polyclonal_downsampled,
  cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp %>% filter(stimulationFigures == "IAR")
)

# Calculate final expansion summary from the downsampled data
final_downsampled_expansion <- final_downsampled_data %>%
  group_by(stimulationFigures) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    .x %>%
      mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))
  }) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pairs = n(),
    expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
    unique_pairs = total_pairs - expanded_pairs,
    expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== Final Downsampled Expansion Summary ===\n")
print(final_downsampled_expansion)

# Note: We will use the more accurate converged_contingency table for the chi-squared test
# (created below in the pairwise comparisons section)

# Pairwise comparisons using converged rates and contingency tables
cat("\n=== Pairwise Comparisons (Converged Downsampled Rates) ===\n")

# Use the converged rates from the main_results
converged_percentages <- data.frame(
  stimulationFigures = c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal"),
  expansion_percentage = c(
    main_results$iar_rate,
    main_results$microbial_rate,
    main_results$polyclonal_rate
  )
)

cat("Using converged rates from iterative analysis:\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(converged_percentages)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.1f%%\n",
    converged_percentages$stimulationFigures[i],
    converged_percentages$expansion_percentage[i]))
}

# Create contingency table with converged rates
# Use the target sample size (IAR count) for all groups since they're all downsampled to this size
converged_contingency <- converged_percentages %>%
  mutate(
    total_cells = iar_count,
    expanded_cells = round(expansion_percentage / 100 * total_cells),
    non_expanded_cells = total_cells - expanded_cells
  ) %>%
  select(stimulationFigures, expanded_cells, non_expanded_cells) %>%
  column_to_rownames("stimulationFigures") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("\nConverged rates contingency table:\n")
print(converged_contingency)

# Perform chi-squared test on converged contingency table (more accurate than downsampled_contingency_table)
downsampled_chi_test <- chisq.test(converged_contingency)

cat("\n=== Downsampled Chi-Square Test Results (Using Converged Rates) ===\n")
cat("Chi-square statistic:", downsampled_chi_test$statistic, "\n")
cat("P-value:", downsampled_chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(downsampled_chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")

# Pairwise Fisher's exact tests on contingency table pairs
all_p_values <- c()
comparison_names <- c()
pairwise_results <- list()

stimulations <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")

for (i in 1:(length(stimulations) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(stimulations)) {
    stim1 <- stimulations[i]
    stim2 <- stimulations[j]

    # Create 2x2 contingency table for this pair
    pair_table <- converged_contingency[c(stim1, stim2), ]

    # Perform Fisher's exact test
    fisher_test <- fisher.test(pair_table)
    p_val <- fisher_test$p.value

    # Store results
    pairwise_results[[paste(stim1, "vs", stim2)]] <- p_val
    all_p_values <- c(all_p_values, p_val)
    comparison_names <- c(comparison_names, paste(stim1, "vs", stim2))
  }
} # Apply BH correction
adj_p_values <- p.adjust(all_p_values, method = "BH")

cat("\n=== Pairwise Results with BH Correction ===\n")
for (k in 1:length(comparison_names)) {
  # Get the expansion percentages for this comparison
  parts <- strsplit(comparison_names[k], " vs ")[[1]]
  stim1 <- parts[1]
  stim2 <- parts[2]
  pct1 <- converged_percentages %>% filter(stimulationFigures == stim1) %>% pull(expansion_percentage)
  pct2 <- converged_percentages %>% filter(stimulationFigures == stim2) %>% pull(expansion_percentage)

  cat(sprintf("%s vs %s (%.1f%% vs %.1f%%) - Raw p: %g, BH-adjusted p: %g",
    stim1, stim2, pct1, pct2, all_p_values[k], adj_p_values[k]))
  if (adj_p_values[k] < 0.05) {
    cat(" (significant after BH correction)")
  } else if (all_p_values[k] < 0.05) {
    cat(" (significant uncorrected)")
  } else {
    cat(" (not significant)")
  }
  cat("\n")
} # Compare original vs downsampled results
cat("\n=== Comparison: Original vs Downsampled ===\n")
cat("Original p-value:", chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Downsampled p-value:", downsampled_chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Change in significance:",
  ifelse(chi_test$p.value < 0.05 && downsampled_chi_test$p.value >= 0.05, "Lost significance",
    ifelse(chi_test$p.value >= 0.05 && downsampled_chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "Gained significance",
      "No change in significance")), "\n")

# Show convergence plot data (first and last 10 iterations)
iteration_results <- main_results$iteration_results
if (nrow(iteration_results) > 20) {
  cat("\n=== Convergence Summary (Downsampled Rates) ===\n")
  cat("First 10 iterations:\n")
  print(head(iteration_results[, c("iteration", "microbial_rate", "polyclonal_rate")], 10))
  cat("Last 10 iterations:\n")
  print(tail(iteration_results[, c("iteration", "microbial_rate", "polyclonal_rate")], 10))
} else {
  cat("\n=== All Iterations (Downsampled Rates) ===\n")
  print(iteration_results[, c("iteration", "microbial_rate", "polyclonal_rate")])
}

# ==========================================Treg 3-way chisquared test=======================================================
# subset to Tregs only
treg_tcr_data <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cellType == "Treg")

# Calculate expansion within each stimulation group separately
expansion_summary <- treg_tcr_data %>%
  group_by(stimulationFigures) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    # Within this stimulation group, identify expanded pairs
    .x %>%
      mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))
  }) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pairs = n(),
    expanded_pairs = sum(expanded),
    unique_pairs = total_pairs - expanded_pairs,
    expansion_rate = expanded_pairs / total_pairs,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("=== Within-Stimulation TCR Expansion Summary ===\n")
print(expansion_summary)

# Create contingency table for chi-square test
contingency_table <- expansion_summary %>%
  mutate(non_expanded_pairs = total_pairs - expanded_pairs) %>%
  select(stimulationFigures, expanded_pairs, non_expanded_pairs) %>%
  column_to_rownames("stimulationFigures") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("\n=== Contingency Table ===\n")
cat("Rows: Stimulation conditions\n")
cat("Columns: [Expanded pairs, Non-expanded pairs]\n")
print(contingency_table)

# Perform chi-square test
chi_test <- chisq.test(contingency_table)

cat("\n=== Chi-Square Test Results ===\n")
cat("Testing: Are TCR expansion rates significantly different between stimulation conditions?\n")
cat("Chi-square statistic:", chi_test$statistic, "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", chi_test$parameter, "\n")
cat("P-value:", chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")

# Check assumptions
cat("\n=== Test Assumptions ===\n")
expected_counts <- chi_test$expected
min_expected <- min(expected_counts)
cat("Minimum expected count:", min_expected, "\n")
cat("All expected counts ≥ 5:", ifelse(min_expected >= 5, "YES (assumption met)", "NO (assumption violated)"), "\n")

if (min_expected < 5) {
  cat("WARNING: Chi-square assumptions may be violated. Consider Fisher's exact test.\n")

  # Perform Fisher's exact test as alternative
  fisher_test <- fisher.test(contingency_table)
  cat("\n=== Fisher's Exact Test (Alternative) ===\n")
  cat("P-value:", fisher_test$p.value, "\n")
  cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(fisher_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")
}

# Post-hoc analysis if significant
if (chi_test$p.value < 0.05) {
  cat("\n=== Post-hoc Pairwise Comparisons ===\n")

  stimulations <- rownames(contingency_table)
  pairwise_p_values <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(stimulations), ncol = length(stimulations),
    dimnames = list(stimulations, stimulations))

  for (i in 1:(length(stimulations) - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):length(stimulations)) {
      pair_table <- contingency_table[c(i, j), ]
      pair_test <- fisher.test(pair_table)
      pairwise_p_values[i, j] <- pair_test$p.value
      pairwise_p_values[j, i] <- pair_test$p.value

      cat(stimulations[i], "vs", stimulations[j], "- p-value:",
        round(pair_test$p.value, 4),
        ifelse(pair_test$p.value < 0.05 / 3, "(significant after Bonferroni)", "(not significant)"), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# ==========================================Treg Downsampled Analysis=======================================================
cat("\n=== Treg Downsampled Analysis (Microbial and Polyclonal to 152 cells) ===\n")
cat("Purpose: Address sample size imbalance by downsampling larger groups to match IAR group size (Tregs only)\n")

# Get IAR cell count for Tregs to determine target sample size
treg_iar_count <- sum(treg_tcr_data$stimulationFigures == "IAR")
cat("IAR Treg cell count:", treg_iar_count, "\n")

# Use the downsampling function for Tregs
treg_results <- perform_downsampling_analysis(
  tcr_data = treg_tcr_data,
  target_sample_size = treg_iar_count,
  section_name = "Treg Downsampled Analysis"
)

# Chi-squared test for Treg expansion percentages
cat("\n=== Treg Chi-Squared Test for Expansion Percentages ===\n")
cat("Testing: Are Treg expansion percentages significantly different between stimulation conditions?\n")

# Extract expansion data from converged results (using iterative analysis converged rates)
treg_expansion_data <- data.frame(
  stimulationFigures = c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal"),
  expansion_percentage = c(
    treg_results$iar_rate,
    treg_results$microbial_rate,
    treg_results$polyclonal_rate
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    total_cells = treg_iar_count,  # All groups downsampled to same size
    expanded_cells = round(expansion_percentage / 100 * total_cells),
    non_expanded_cells = total_cells - expanded_cells
  )

# Create contingency table using converged rates
treg_contingency <- treg_expansion_data %>%
  dplyr::select(stimulationFigures, expanded_cells, non_expanded_cells) %>%
  column_to_rownames("stimulationFigures") %>%
  as.matrix()

cat("\nTreg Contingency Table:\n")
print(treg_contingency)

# Perform chi-square test
treg_chi_test <- chisq.test(treg_contingency)

cat("\nChi-square statistic:", treg_chi_test$statistic, "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom:", treg_chi_test$parameter, "\n")
cat("P-value:", treg_chi_test$p.value, "\n")
cat("Significant at α=0.05:", ifelse(treg_chi_test$p.value < 0.05, "YES", "NO"), "\n")

# Check assumptions
treg_min_expected <- min(treg_chi_test$expected)
cat("Minimum expected count:", treg_min_expected, "\n")
cat("All expected counts ≥ 5:", ifelse(treg_min_expected >= 5, "YES (assumption met)", "NO (assumption violated)"), "\n")

if (treg_min_expected < 5) {
  cat("WARNING: Chi-square assumptions may be violated. Consider Fisher's exact test.\n")
  treg_fisher_test <- fisher.test(treg_contingency)
  cat("Fisher's exact test P-value:", treg_fisher_test$p.value, "\n")
}

# Pairwise comparisons for Treg expansion percentages using contingency tables
cat("\n=== Treg Pairwise Comparisons ===\n")

# Extract the three expansion percentages from treg_results
treg_percentages <- data.frame(
  stimulationFigures = c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal"),
  expansion_percentage = c(
    treg_results$iar_rate,
    treg_results$microbial_rate,
    treg_results$polyclonal_rate
  )
)

cat("Treg converged expansion rates:\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(treg_percentages)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.1f%%\n",
    treg_percentages$stimulationFigures[i],
    treg_percentages$expansion_percentage[i]))
}

# Use the already computed treg_contingency table for pairwise tests
cat("\nTreg contingency table:\n")
print(treg_contingency)

# Pairwise Fisher's exact tests on contingency table pairs
treg_stimulations <- rownames(treg_contingency)
all_p_values <- c()
comparison_names <- c()
treg_pairwise_results <- list()

for (i in 1:(length(treg_stimulations) - 1)) {
  for (j in (i + 1):length(treg_stimulations)) {
    stim1 <- treg_stimulations[i]
    stim2 <- treg_stimulations[j]

    # Create 2x2 contingency table for this pair
    pair_table <- treg_contingency[c(stim1, stim2), ]

    # Perform Fisher's exact test
    fisher_test <- fisher.test(pair_table)
    p_val <- fisher_test$p.value

    # Store results
    treg_pairwise_results[[paste(stim1, "vs", stim2)]] <- p_val
    all_p_values <- c(all_p_values, p_val)
    comparison_names <- c(comparison_names, paste(stim1, "vs", stim2))
  }
}

# Apply BH correction
adj_p_values <- p.adjust(all_p_values, method = "BH")

cat("\n=== Treg Pairwise Results with BH Correction ===\n")
for (k in 1:length(comparison_names)) {
  # Get the expansion percentages for this comparison
  parts <- strsplit(comparison_names[k], " vs ")[[1]]
  stim1 <- parts[1]
  stim2 <- parts[2]
  pct1 <- treg_percentages %>% filter(stimulationFigures == stim1) %>% pull(expansion_percentage)
  pct2 <- treg_percentages %>% filter(stimulationFigures == stim2) %>% pull(expansion_percentage)

  cat(sprintf("%s vs %s (%.1f%% vs %.1f%%) - Raw p: %g, BH-adjusted p: %g",
    stim1, stim2, pct1, pct2, all_p_values[k], adj_p_values[k]))
  if (adj_p_values[k] < 0.05) {
    cat(" (significant after BH correction)")
  } else if (all_p_values[k] < 0.05) {
    cat(" (significant uncorrected)")
  } else {
    cat(" (not significant)")
  }
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r TconvAndTregProportionExactTests}
# ============================================Tregs Exact tests===============================================================
# Re-calculate expansion status within each stimulation for Treg TCR pairs
treg_tcr_data <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cellType == "Treg")

# Find expanded TCR pairs within each stimulation
treg_tcr_expanded <- treg_tcr_data %>%

  ungroup()

  treg_tcr_expanded$expanded
)

# For each pairwise comparison:
get_fisher_table <- function(group1, group2) {
  tab <- table(
    treg_tcr_expanded$stimulationFigures,
    treg_tcr_expanded$expanded
  )
  # Only keep rows for the two groups
  tab2 <- tab[c(group1, group2), ]
  # Remove NAs if present
  tab2 <- tab2[, c("TRUE", "FALSE"), drop = FALSE]
  return(tab2)
}

cat("\n=== Fisher Exact Tests ===\n")

  P_value = pvals,

cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp %>%
  mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))

cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp <- subset(cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp, subset = expanded == TRUE)

# DS Microbial cells Tconv
cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df

seurat.tmp <- subset(seuratQCMergedCleanedDS, subset = stimulationFigures == "Microbial")
seurat.tmp <- subset(seurat.tmp, subset = cellType == "Tconv")

microbialDSBarcodes.tmp <- rownames(seurat.tmp@meta.data)

cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df %>%
  subset(subset = barcode %in% microbialDSBarcodes.tmp)

cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp <- cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp %>%
  mutate(expanded = ifelse(fullLengthNT %in% fullLengthNT[duplicated(fullLengthNT)], 1, 0))

cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp <- subset(cleanTCRAgSpecificDSMicrobialPairs.df.tmp, subset = expanded == TRUE)

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```

# New figure variants (added 2026-05)

## Combined Treg + Tconv curated stair-step dotplot
```{r FigureS4C}
# FigureS4C

# Combined Treg + Tconv dotplot of the curated gene lists, rows = cluster
# labels like "0_Treg", "1_Tconv", single shared color scale, genes ordered
# diagonally (stair-step) by peak-expression cluster.

dotPlotDotSize <- 3.75

# Treg+Tconv subset and combined cluster identity
seurat.tmp <- subset(seuratAgSpecific, cellType %in% c("Treg", "Tconv"))
seurat.tmp <- buildCombinedClusterIdent(seurat.tmp)

# Pool the `curated` columns from both gene-list data frames
genes.tmp <- unique(c(
  geneListsTreg.df$curated,
  geneListsTconv.df$curated
))
genes.tmp <- genes.tmp[!is.na(genes.tmp)]
genes.tmp <- intersect(genes.tmp, rownames(seurat.tmp))

cat("Combined curated dotplot: using", length(genes.tmp), "genes across",
  length(levels(seurat.tmp$clusterCellType)), "cluster_cellType groups\n")

# Stair-step ordering of genes by peak-expression group
genesOrdered <- orderGenesByExpression(seurat.tmp, genes.tmp,
  groupBy = "clusterCellType")

# Single DotPlot call -> a single shared color scale across all rows
dotPlot.tmp <- DotPlot(seurat.tmp,
  features = genesOrdered,
  group.by = "clusterCellType",
  dot.scale = dotPlotDotSize) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = fontSize),
    text = element_text(size = fontSize),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = fontSize),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
    legend.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
    legend.title = element_text(size = fontSize),
    strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
    plot.title = element_text(size = fontSize)) +
  labs(y = "Cluster_CellType", x = "Curated Treg + Tconv genes (stair-step ordered)") +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "Average\nExpression\nz-score"),
    size = guide_legend(title = "Percent\nExpressed")) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red")

# auto width: ~0.16 in per gene plus 4 in for axes/legend
plotWidth <- max(8, 4 + length(genesOrdered) * 0.16)

savePlot(
  plot = dotPlot.tmp,
  plotDir = plotDir,
  filename = "combined_TregTconv_curated_dotplot_stairstep",
  height = 5,
  width = plotWidth,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  formats = c("pdf", "png")
)

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
```

## Curated dotplot grouped by gene category (combined, Treg-only, Tconv-only)
```{r TregTconv_curated_grouped_dotplot_REMOVED}
# Like the stair-step dotplot above, but genes are grouped into functional
# categories (Activation / Naive / Memory / Treg / Th subsets / Function) per
# the curated layout (image005). Category membership + within-category order are
# read from the `curatedGrouped` sheet of CD4_Treg_geneLists.xlsx. Produces, for
# each of the combined Treg+Tconv, Treg-only, and Tconv-only subsets, one
# all-stimulation figure plus one figure per stimulation.

dotPlotDotSize <- 3.75
fontSize <- 8
stim_levels <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")

# Grouped gene list (gene, category, order) from the xlsx sheet
groupedDf <- read.xlsx(file.path(dataInputDir, "CD4_Treg_geneLists.xlsx"),
  sheet = "curatedGrouped")
groupedDf <- groupedDf[order(groupedDf$order), ]
catLevels <- unique(groupedDf$category)

# Build a grouped DotPlot for a given Treg+Tconv Seurat subset. Reuses Seurat's
# DotPlot to compute scaled mean expression + percent expressed, then re-plots
# the DotPlot data with one panel per gene category (panel widths proportional
# to the number of genes via facet space = "free_x").
make_grouped_dotplot <- function(seuratSub, tag) {
  genesPresent <- intersect(groupedDf$gene, rownames(seuratSub))
  missing <- setdiff(groupedDf$gene, rownames(seuratSub))
  if (length(missing)) {
    cat("Grouped dotplot [", tag, "]: dropping", length(missing),
      "gene(s) absent from object:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  gdf <- groupedDf[groupedDf$gene %in% genesPresent, ]
  gdf$category <- factor(gdf$category, levels = catLevels)
  geneOrder <- gdf$gene[order(gdf$category, gdf$order)]

  dp <- DotPlot(seuratSub, features = geneOrder,
    group.by = "clusterCellType", dot.scale = dotPlotDotSize)

  pdat <- dp$data
  pdat$features.plot <- factor(as.character(pdat$features.plot), levels = geneOrder)
  pdat$category <- factor(
    gdf$category[match(as.character(pdat$features.plot), gdf$gene)],
    levels = catLevels)

  ggplot(pdat, aes(x = features.plot, y = id,
      color = avg.exp.scaled, size = pct.exp)) +
    geom_point() +
    facet_grid(~ category, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red") +
    guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "Average\nExpression\nz-score"),
      size = guide_legend(title = "Percent\nExpressed")) +
    labs(y = "Cluster_CellType",
      x = "Curated Treg + Tconv genes (grouped by category)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = fontSize) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = fontSize),
      text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.title = element_text(size = fontSize),
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      panel.spacing = unit(2, "pt"))
}

plotWidth <- max(8, 4 + nrow(groupedDf) * 0.16)

# Cell-type subsets: combined Treg+Tconv, Treg-only, Tconv-only. For each, one
# all-stimulation figure plus one figure per stimulation. group.by is always
# clusterCellType; on a single-cellType subset buildCombinedClusterIdent yields
# only that cellType's cluster levels (e.g. "0_Treg", "1_Treg", ...).
cellTypeSets <- list(
  list(tag = "TregTconv", cellTypes = c("Treg", "Tconv"),
    prefix = "combined_TregTconv"),
  list(tag = "Treg",  cellTypes = "Treg",  prefix = "Treg"),
  list(tag = "Tconv", cellTypes = "Tconv", prefix = "Tconv")
)

for (cts in cellTypeSets) {
  ctFilter <- cts$cellTypes

  # All-stimulation figure
  seurat.tmp <- subset(seuratAgSpecific, subset = cellType %in% ctFilter)
  seurat.tmp <- buildCombinedClusterIdent(seurat.tmp)
  savePlot(
    plot = make_grouped_dotplot(seurat.tmp, paste0(cts$tag, "_allStim")),
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0(cts$prefix, "_curated_grouped_dotplot"),
    height = 5,
    width = plotWidth,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 600,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Per-stimulation figures
  for (stim in stim_levels) {
    seuratStim <- subset(seuratAgSpecific,
      subset = cellType %in% ctFilter & stimulationFigures == stim)
    seuratStim <- buildCombinedClusterIdent(seuratStim)
    savePlot(
      plot = make_grouped_dotplot(seuratStim, paste0(cts$tag, "_", stim)),
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = paste0(cts$prefix, "_curated_grouped_dotplot_", stim),
      height = 5,
      width = plotWidth,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 600,
      formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
```

```{r tregSignatures_perGene_heatmap_REMOVED}
# Per-gene z-score heatmap per signature, aggregated by donorId x
# clusterCellType (matches Fig S2 aggregation, but with cluster_cellType
# instead of donor_cellType columns).

fontSize <- 8

for (sigName in names(signatureGeneSets)) {
  sigGenes <- signatureGeneSets[[sigName]]
  if (length(sigGenes) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", sigName, "- fewer than 2 genes present\n")
    next
  }

  md <- seuratTregTconv@meta.data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("rn") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      donor_clusterCellType = paste(donorIdFigures, clusterCellType, sep = "__")
    )
  rownames(md) <- md$rn

  exprMat <- GetAssayData(seuratTregTconv, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[sigGenes, rownames(md)]
  exprDf <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(exprMat)))
  exprDf$donor_clusterCellType <- md$donor_clusterCellType

  aggMean <- exprDf %>%
    dplyr::group_by(donor_clusterCellType) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), mean), .groups = "drop")

  aggMat <- as.matrix(aggMean[, -1])
  rownames(aggMat) <- aggMean$donor_clusterCellType
  aggMat <- t(aggMat) # genes x samples

  # Drop genes with zero variance to avoid scale() NaNs
  rowVars <- apply(aggMat, 1, stats::var)
  aggMat <- aggMat[!is.na(rowVars) & rowVars > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(aggMat) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping", sigName, "- not enough variable genes after aggregation\n")
    next
  }

  zScores <- t(scale(t(aggMat)))

  # Sample-level annotation (one column per donor x cluster_cellType)
  ann <- tibble::tibble(donor_clusterCellType = colnames(zScores)) %>%
    tidyr::separate(donor_clusterCellType,
      into = c("donorIdFigures", "clusterCellType"),
      sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cellType = ifelse(grepl("_Treg$", clusterCellType), "Treg", "Tconv"),
      cluster = sub("_(Treg|Tconv)$", "", clusterCellType)
    )

  annCols <- list(
    "Cell Type" = palCellType,
    "Donor ID" = palDonorId
  )
  topAnn <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Cell Type" = ann$cellType,
    "Cluster" = ann$cluster,
    "Donor ID" = ann$donorIdFigures,
    col = annCols,
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize, fontface = "plain"),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      "Cell Type" = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize)),
      "Donor ID"  = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize))
    )
  )

  heatmap_colors <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red"))

  heatmap.tmp <- Heatmap(
    zScores,
    name = "Z-score",
    top_annotation = topAnn,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = TRUE,
    col = heatmap_colors,
    border = TRUE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize)
    )
  )

  savePlot(
    plot = heatmap.tmp,
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("signatureHeatmap_", sigName,
      "_byDonor_clusterCellType"),
    height = max(6, 0.12 * nrow(zScores) + 4),
    width = 12,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 600,
    formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
```

## Treg signatures, per-stimulation variants
```{r tregSignatures_perStimulation_variants_REMOVED}
# Stimulation-specific versions of the three signature displays above
# (per-gene heatmap, per-gene stair-step bubbleplot, module-score boxplot).
# For each stimulation we subset the Treg+Tconv object, rebuild the combined
# cluster identity on that subset, and emit the same three figure types with a
# `_<stim>` filename suffix. The all-stimulation figures above are unchanged.

fontSize <- 8
dotPlotDotSize <- 3.75
stim_levels <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")

# Per-gene z-score heatmap (returns a Heatmap or NULL if not enough data)
makeSignatureHeatmap <- function(seuratObj, sigGenes, tag) {
  sigGenes <- intersect(sigGenes, rownames(seuratObj))
  if (length(sigGenes) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping heatmap", tag, "- fewer than 2 genes present\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  md <- seuratObj@meta.data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("rn") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      donor_clusterCellType = paste(donorIdFigures, clusterCellType, sep = "__"))
  rownames(md) <- md$rn

  exprMat <- GetAssayData(seuratObj, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")[sigGenes, rownames(md)]
  exprDf <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(exprMat)))
  exprDf$donor_clusterCellType <- md$donor_clusterCellType

  aggMean <- exprDf %>%
    dplyr::group_by(donor_clusterCellType) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), mean), .groups = "drop")
  aggMat <- as.matrix(aggMean[, -1])
  rownames(aggMat) <- aggMean$donor_clusterCellType
  aggMat <- t(aggMat)

  rowVars <- apply(aggMat, 1, stats::var)
  aggMat <- aggMat[!is.na(rowVars) & rowVars > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(aggMat) < 2 || ncol(aggMat) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping heatmap", tag, "- not enough variable genes/samples\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  zScores <- t(scale(t(aggMat)))

  ann <- tibble::tibble(donor_clusterCellType = colnames(zScores)) %>%
    tidyr::separate(donor_clusterCellType,
      into = c("donorIdFigures", "clusterCellType"), sep = "__", remove = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cellType = ifelse(grepl("_Treg$", clusterCellType), "Treg", "Tconv"),
      cluster = sub("_(Treg|Tconv)$", "", clusterCellType))

  topAnn <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    "Cell Type" = ann$cellType,
    "Cluster" = ann$cluster,
    "Donor ID" = ann$donorIdFigures,
    col = list("Cell Type" = palCellType, "Donor ID" = palDonorId),
    annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize, fontface = "plain"),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      "Cell Type" = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize)),
      "Donor ID"  = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize))))

  Heatmap(zScores, name = "Z-score", top_annotation = topAnn,
    show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE,
    col = colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("blue", "white", "red")), border = TRUE,
    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize), column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize),
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = fontSize)))
}

# Per-gene stair-step bubbleplot (returns a ggplot or NULL)
makeSignatureBubble <- function(seuratObj, sigGenes, sigName) {
  sigGenes <- intersect(sigGenes, rownames(seuratObj))
  if (length(sigGenes) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping bubbleplot", sigName, "- fewer than 2 genes present\n"); return(NULL)
  }
  genesOrdered <- orderGenesByExpression(seuratObj, sigGenes, groupBy = "clusterCellType")
  DotPlot(seuratObj, features = genesOrdered, group.by = "clusterCellType",
    dot.scale = dotPlotDotSize) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = fontSize),
      text = element_text(size = fontSize), axis.text.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = fontSize), axis.title.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.text = element_text(size = fontSize), legend.title = element_text(size = fontSize),
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize), plot.title = element_text(size = fontSize)) +
    labs(y = "Cluster_CellType", x = paste0(sigName, " signature (stair-step ordered)")) +
    guides(color = guide_colorbar(title = "Average\nExpression\nz-score"),
      size = guide_legend(title = "Percent\nExpressed")) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red")
}

for (stim in stim_levels) {
  seuratStim <- subset(seuratTregTconv, stimulationFigures == stim)
  if (ncol(seuratStim) < 10) {
    cat("Skipping stimulation", stim, "- too few cells\n"); next
  }
  seuratStim <- buildCombinedClusterIdent(seuratStim)

  # Heatmap + bubbleplot per signature
  for (sigName in names(signatureGeneSets)) {
    sigGenes <- signatureGeneSets[[sigName]]

    hm <- makeSignatureHeatmap(seuratStim, sigGenes, paste(sigName, stim))
    if (!is.null(hm)) {
      savePlot(plot = hm, plotDir = plotDir,
        filename = paste0("signatureHeatmap_", sigName, "_", stim,
          "_byDonor_clusterCellType"),
        height = max(6, 0.12 * length(intersect(sigGenes, rownames(seuratStim))) + 4),
        width = 12, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png"))
    }

    bub <- makeSignatureBubble(seuratStim, sigGenes, sigName)
    if (!is.null(bub)) {
      genesN <- length(intersect(sigGenes, rownames(seuratStim)))
      savePlot(plot = bub, plotDir = plotDir,
        filename = paste0("signatureDotPlot_", sigName, "_", stim,
          "_byClusterCellType"),
        height = 5, width = max(8, 4 + genesN * 0.16),
        units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png"))
    }
  }

  # Module-score boxplot (recompute AddModuleScore on this stimulation's cells)
  seuratStim <- AddModuleScore(seuratStim, features = signatureGeneSets, name = "sigScore_")
  scoreCols <- paste0("sigScore_", seq_along(signatureGeneSets))
  names(scoreCols) <- names(signatureGeneSets)
  scoreDfStim <- seuratStim@meta.data %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("rn") %>%
    dplyr::select(rn, clusterCellType, cellType, dplyr::all_of(unname(scoreCols))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(unname(scoreCols)),
      names_to = "scoreCol", values_to = "moduleScore") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(signature = names(scoreCols)[match(scoreCol, scoreCols)])

  plotStim.tmp <- ggplot(scoreDfStim,
      aes(x = clusterCellType, y = moduleScore, fill = cellType)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 0.3, alpha = 0.3, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~ signature, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palCellType) +
    labs(x = "Cluster_CellType", y = "Module score (AddModuleScore)", fill = "Cell Type") +
    theme_classic(base_size = fontSize) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = fontSize),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5))

  savePlot(plot = plotStim.tmp, plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("signatureModuleScores_Hollbacher_Cheng_", stim,
      "_byClusterCellType"),
    height = 6, width = 7, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png"))
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```

## Combined Hollbacher + Cheng dotplot, signature source annotated
```{r tregSignatures_combined_sourceAnnotated_dotplot_REMOVED}
# One dotplot showing the UNION of the Hollbacher and Cheng Treg signatures, with
# each gene annotated by its source (Hollbacher / Cheng / Both) - styled after the
# colleague's combined plot. Source is encoded by the color of the gene (x-axis)
# label plus a "Signature source" legend (kept within our plotting conventions
# rather than reproducing his exact sub-axis dots / dot sizes). Genes come from
# our existing present-gene lists (hollbacherPresent / chengPresent), so genes he
# dropped for low expression in the plate-sorted data are retained here.
# Variants: (combined stims + each of IAR / Microbial / Polyclonal) x
# (Treg+Tconv, Treg-only, Tconv-only) = 12 figures.

fontSize <- 8
dotPlotDotSize <- 3.75
stim_levels <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")

# Union of present signature genes + per-gene source classification
combinedSigGenes <- unique(c(hollbacherPresent, chengPresent))
bothGenes <- intersect(hollbacherPresent, chengPresent)
sourceColors <- c(Hollbacher = "red", Cheng = "blue", Both = "purple")
classifySource <- function(g) ifelse(g %in% bothGenes, "Both",
  ifelse(g %in% hollbacherPresent, "Hollbacher", "Cheng"))

make_combined_sig_dotplot <- function(seuratSub, tag) {
  genes <- intersect(combinedSigGenes, rownames(seuratSub))
  if (length(genes) < 2 || ncol(seuratSub) < 10) {
    cat("Skipping combined signature dotplot [", tag, "] - too few genes/cells\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  genesOrdered <- orderGenesByExpression(seuratSub, genes,
    groupBy = "clusterCellType")
  geneSource <- classifySource(genesOrdered)
  names(geneSource) <- genesOrdered

  dp <- DotPlot(seuratSub, features = genesOrdered,
    group.by = "clusterCellType", dot.scale = dotPlotDotSize)
  pdat <- dp$data
  pdat$features.plot <- factor(as.character(pdat$features.plot), levels = genesOrdered)

  # Invisible squares (shape 22 uses `fill`, a separate scale from the dot
  # `color` gradient) to generate the "Signature source" legend.
  yLev <- levels(pdat$id)[1]
  srcDf <- data.frame(
    gene = factor(genesOrdered, levels = genesOrdered),
    source = factor(geneSource[genesOrdered],
      levels = c("Hollbacher", "Cheng", "Both")))

  ggplot(pdat, aes(x = features.plot, y = id)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = avg.exp.scaled, size = pct.exp)) +
    geom_point(data = srcDf, aes(x = gene, y = yLev, fill = source),
      shape = 22, alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red") +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Signature source", values = sourceColors,
      drop = FALSE) +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(title = "Average\nExpression\nz-score"),
      size = guide_legend(title = "Percent\nExpressed"),
      fill = guide_legend(order = 3, override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))) +
    labs(y = "Cluster_CellType",
      x = "Hollbacher + Cheng Treg markers (stair-step ordered)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = fontSize,
        color = unname(sourceColors[geneSource[genesOrdered]])),
      text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.title = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.justification = "top",
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      plot.title = element_text(size = fontSize))
}

nGenesCombined <- length(intersect(combinedSigGenes, rownames(seuratTregTconv)))
plotWidth <- max(8, 4 + nGenesCombined * 0.16)

cellTypeSets <- list(
  list(tag = "TregTconv", cellTypes = c("Treg", "Tconv")),
  list(tag = "Treg",  cellTypes = "Treg"),
  list(tag = "Tconv", cellTypes = "Tconv"))

# stim options: combined (all 3) + each stimulation on its own
stimSets <- c(list(allStim = stim_levels),
  setNames(as.list(stim_levels), stim_levels))

for (cts in cellTypeSets) {
  ctFilter <- cts$cellTypes
  for (stimTag in names(stimSets)) {
    stimFilter <- stimSets[[stimTag]]
    seuratSub <- subset(seuratTregTconv,
      subset = cellType %in% ctFilter & stimulationFigures %in% stimFilter)
    if (ncol(seuratSub) < 10) {
      cat("Skipping combined signature dotplot [", cts$tag, stimTag,
        "] - too few cells\n"); next
    }
    seuratSub <- buildCombinedClusterIdent(seuratSub)

    p <- make_combined_sig_dotplot(seuratSub, paste(cts$tag, stimTag))
    if (is.null(p)) next
    savePlot(
      plot = p,
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = paste0("signatureDotPlot_HollbacherCheng_combined_",
        cts$tag, "_", stimTag, "_byClusterCellType"),
      height = 6.5, width = plotWidth, units = "in", dpi = 600,
      formats = c("pdf", "png"))
  }
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```

## TCR subsampled stats (shared by expansion + Inverse Simpson)
```{r tcrSubsampledStats_compute}
# Compute per-donor TCR statistics ONCE so the expansion-proportion and the
# Inverse-Simpson figures use the *identical* pseudorandom downsamples (the
# subsampling draws are generated inside a single function call per variant, and
# both metrics are computed on the same draws). Mirrors the paired plate-sorted
# reference (getSharingSubsampled / getDiversitySubsampled). The reference used
# N = 1000 for sharing and N = 100 for diversity; because we need ONE shared set
# of draws for both, a single N is used here (adjust nSubsample as desired).
nSubsample <- 100

tcrStats_nodown <- subsampledTcrStatsByChain(
  seuratAgSpecific, cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df,
  stimulations = c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal"),
  chains = c("TRA", "TRB", "pair"),
  N = nSubsample, downsample = FALSE, seed = 314)

tcrStats_downsmp <- subsampledTcrStatsByChain(
  seuratAgSpecific, cleanTCRAgSpecificPairs.df,
  stimulations = c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal"),
  chains = c("TRA", "TRB", "pair"),
  N = nSubsample, downsample = TRUE, seed = 314)
```

## Tconv vs Treg NT-expansion proportion per donor (TRA / TRB / pair)
```{r FigureS6C}
# Figure S6C
# Tconv vs Treg "expansion proportion" = proportion of cells whose chain
# sequence is shared (appears >= 2x) per donor, across IAR / Microbial /
# Polyclonal, for the TRA, TRB and alpha-beta pair chains. Quantity + subsampling
# match the paired plate-sorted reference (see subsampledTcrStatsByChain) and the
# SAME draws are reused for the Inverse-Simpson figures (shared tcrStats_*).
# Significance: paired t-test on per-donor (Tconv - Treg) differences within each
# (stim, studyGroup, chain), BH-adjusted; Padj shown in the colored HC/T1D header
# (per-stim figures) or annotated per panel (3-stim grid). Per chain: one 3-stim
# faceted figure + three per-stim figures, in both downsample variants.

fontSize <- 8

# HC / T1D display factor + palette derived from palStudyGroup.
basePalStudyGroup <- if (exists("palStudyGroup")) palStudyGroup else
  c("Control" = "lightblue", "T1D" = "orange")
studyGroupRecode <- c("Control" = "HC", "T1D" = "T1D")
studyGroup_levels <- c("HC", "T1D")
palStudyGroup_local <- setNames(
  basePalStudyGroup[names(studyGroupRecode)],
  unname(studyGroupRecode[names(studyGroupRecode)])
) # c(HC = lightblue, T1D = orange)

stim_levels  <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")
chain_levels <- c("TRA", "TRB", "pair")

# Plot helper: x = cellType, facet stim x studyGroup. padjInHeader places "Padj"
# in the colored HC/T1D column header (per-stim figures); otherwise it is
# annotated on each panel (3-stim grid, whose shared headers can't carry it).
filterExpansionStim <- function(df, stimsToShow) {
  df %>% dplyr::filter(stimulationFigures %in% stimsToShow)
}

# donorIdFigures -> plain donorId lookup (donorIdFigures is the sanitized
# display id used for figure grouping/coloring, not a real identifier).
donorLookup_expansion <- seuratAgSpecific@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(donorIdFigures, donorId)

# Exact per-donor data underlying the boxplot/line/point geoms for one panel
# set (i.e. what filterExpansionStim() hands to make_expansion_plot()).
exportExpansionSourceData <- function(df_sub, filePath) {
  sourceData <- df_sub %>%
    dplyr::left_join(donorLookup_expansion, by = "donorIdFigures") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      donorId,
      studyGroup,
      stimulation = stimulationFigures,
      chain,
      cellType,
      nCells = n_cells,
      propExpandedNT
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(chain, stimulation, studyGroup, cellType, donorId)
  write.csv(sourceData, filePath, row.names = FALSE)
}

make_expansion_plot <- function(df, stats, stimsToShow, padjInHeader = FALSE) {
  df_sub    <- filterExpansionStim(df, stimsToShow)
  stats_sub <- filterExpansionStim(stats, stimsToShow)

  rowStripLevels <- intersect(levels(df_sub$stimulationFigures), stimsToShow)
  colStripLevels <- intersect(studyGroup_levels,
    as.character(unique(df_sub$studyGroupLabel)))
  rowStripFills <- lapply(palStimulation[rowStripLevels], function(clr)
    element_rect(fill = clr, color = "black"))
  colStripFills <- lapply(palStudyGroup_local[colStripLevels], function(clr)
    element_rect(fill = clr, color = "black"))

  if (isTRUE(padjInHeader)) {
    lab_map <- stats_sub %>%
      dplyr::distinct(studyGroupLabel, adj_p, n_paired) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lab = ifelse(is.na(adj_p),
        paste0(studyGroupLabel, "\n(n=", n_paired, ", ns)"),
        paste0(studyGroupLabel, "\nPadj = ", signif(adj_p, 3))))
    colLab <- setNames(lab_map$lab, as.character(lab_map$studyGroupLabel))
    facetLabeller <- ggplot2::labeller(studyGroupLabel = colLab)
  } else {
    facetLabeller <- ggplot2::label_value
  }

  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = cellType, y = propExpandedNT)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, color = "black") +
    geom_line(aes(group = donorIdFigures), color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "black") +
    ggh4x::facet_grid2(stimulationFigures ~ studyGroupLabel,
      labeller = facetLabeller,
      strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
        background_x = colStripFills,
        background_y = rowStripFills
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion of cells with shared\nNT sequence (per donor)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = fontSize) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.text = element_text(size = fontSize, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = fontSize)
    )

  if (!isTRUE(padjInHeader)) {
    ann_df <- df_sub %>%
      dplyr::group_by(stimulationFigures, studyGroupLabel) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(ann_y = max(propExpandedNT, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1 + 0.02,
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(stats_sub,
        by = c("stimulationFigures", "studyGroupLabel")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(adj_p),
        paste0("ns (n=", n_paired, ")"),
        paste0("Padj = ", signif(adj_p, 3))))
    p <- p + geom_text(
      data = ann_df,
      aes(x = 1.5, y = ann_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 2.8
    )
  }
  p
}

sourceDataDir <- file.path(dataOutputDir, "figureSourceData")
dir.create(sourceDataDir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

variants <- list(nodownsample = tcrStats_nodown, downsampled = tcrStats_downsmp)
for (variantTag in names(variants)) {
  statsAll <- variants[[variantTag]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stimulationFigures = factor(stimulationFigures, levels = stim_levels),
      cellType = factor(cellType, levels = c("Tconv", "Treg")),
      chain = factor(chain, levels = chain_levels),
      studyGroupLabel = factor(
        dplyr::recode(as.character(studyGroup), !!!studyGroupRecode),
        levels = studyGroup_levels)
    )

  write.csv(
    statsAll,
    file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix,
      "expandedNT_TregVsTconv_perDonor_", variantTag, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Paired t-test on per-donor (Tconv - Treg) diffs per (stim, studyGroup, chain),
  # BH-adjusted across all such tests in this variant.
  test_results <- pairedDiffTest(statsAll, "propExpandedNT",
      c("stimulationFigures", "studyGroup", "chain")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stimulationFigures = factor(stimulationFigures, levels = stim_levels),
      chain = factor(chain, levels = chain_levels),
      studyGroupLabel = factor(
        dplyr::recode(as.character(studyGroup), !!!studyGroupRecode),
        levels = studyGroup_levels)
    )

  cat("\n=== expandedNT_TregVsTconv (", variantTag, ") Padj ===\n", sep = "")
  print(test_results %>% dplyr::select(stimulationFigures, studyGroup, chain,
    n_paired, p_val, adj_p))

  for (ch in chain_levels) {
    df_ch    <- statsAll     %>% dplyr::filter(chain == ch)
    stats_ch <- test_results %>% dplyr::filter(chain == ch)

    # 3-stim faceted figure (padj annotated on panels)
    facetedFilename <- paste0("expandedNT_TregVsTconv_", ch, "_faceted_", variantTag)
    savePlot(
      plot = make_expansion_plot(df_ch, stats_ch, stim_levels, padjInHeader = FALSE),
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = facetedFilename,
      height = 7, width = 5.5, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
    exportExpansionSourceData(
      filterExpansionStim(df_ch, stim_levels),
      file.path(sourceDataDir, paste0("FigureS6C_", facetedFilename, ".csv"))
    )

    # Per-stimulation figures (Padj in HC/T1D header)
    for (stim in stim_levels) {
      stimFilename <- paste0("expandedNT_TregVsTconv_", ch, "_", stim, "_", variantTag)
      savePlot(
        plot = make_expansion_plot(df_ch, stats_ch, stim, padjInHeader = TRUE),
        plotDir = plotDir,
        filename = stimFilename,
        height = 3.5, width = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png")
      )
      exportExpansionSourceData(
        filterExpansionStim(df_ch, stim),
        file.path(sourceDataDir, paste0("FigureS6C_", stimFilename, ".csv"))
      )
    }
  }
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```

## Inverse Simpson's TCR diversity, Treg vs Tconv (per chain)
```{r inverseSimpson_TregVsTconv_compute_and_plot_REMOVED}
# Inverse Simpson's diversity (1 / sum p_i^2) of NT-level TCR clones, Tconv vs
# Treg per donor, faceted by chain (TRA | TRB), colored by study group (HC / T1D)
# - the image004 panel. Uses the SAME shared subsamples as the expansion figures
# (tcrStats_*), so the two analyses are downsampled identically. Significance:
# paired t-test on per-donor (Tconv - Treg) diffs per (stim, chain) pooled across
# study groups, BH-adjusted; Padj is shown in the chain header (per-stim) or
# annotated per panel (all-stim grid). Both downsample variants.

fontSize <- 8

basePalStudyGroup <- if (exists("palStudyGroup")) palStudyGroup else
  c("Control" = "lightblue", "T1D" = "orange")
studyGroupRecode <- c("Control" = "HC", "T1D" = "T1D")
studyGroup_levels <- c("HC", "T1D")
palStudyGroup_local <- setNames(
  basePalStudyGroup[names(studyGroupRecode)],
  unname(studyGroupRecode[names(studyGroupRecode)])
)

stim_levels      <- c("IAR", "Microbial", "Polyclonal")
chain_levels_div <- c("TRA", "TRB")

# Chain-strip labels embedding Padj, for a given (single-stim) stats subset.
chainLabelsWithPadj <- function(stats_sub) {
  lab <- stats_sub %>%
    dplyr::distinct(chain, adj_p, n_paired) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(lab = ifelse(is.na(adj_p),
      paste0(chain, "\n(n=", n_paired, ", ns)"),
      paste0(chain, "\nPadj = ", signif(adj_p, 3))))
  setNames(lab$lab, as.character(lab$chain))
}

make_simpson_plot <- function(df, stats, stimsToShow, faceted) {
  df_sub    <- df    %>% dplyr::filter(stimulationFigures %in% stimsToShow)
  stats_sub <- stats %>% dplyr::filter(stimulationFigures %in% stimsToShow)

  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = cellType, y = invSimpson)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, color = "gray50") +
    geom_line(aes(group = donorIdFigures, color = studyGroupLabel), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(color = studyGroupLabel), size = 1.2) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Study group", values = palStudyGroup_local) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Inverse Simpson's\nDiversity by donor") +
    theme_classic(base_size = fontSize) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      axis.text = element_text(size = fontSize, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.text = element_text(size = fontSize),
      legend.title = element_text(size = fontSize)
    )

  if (isTRUE(faceted)) {
    # all-stim grid: stim x chain, Padj annotated on each panel
    p <- p + facet_grid(stimulationFigures ~ chain)
    ann_df <- df_sub %>%
      dplyr::group_by(stimulationFigures, chain) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(ann_y = max(invSimpson, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::left_join(stats_sub, by = c("stimulationFigures", "chain")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(adj_p),
        paste0("ns (n=", n_paired, ")"),
        paste0("Padj = ", signif(adj_p, 3))))
    p <- p + geom_text(data = ann_df, aes(x = 1.5, y = ann_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", size = 2.6)
  } else {
    # per-stim: chain headers carry Padj
    p <- p + facet_wrap(~ chain,
      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(chain = chainLabelsWithPadj(stats_sub)))
  }
  p
}

variants <- list(nodownsample = tcrStats_nodown, downsampled = tcrStats_downsmp)
for (variantTag in names(variants)) {
  div_df <- variants[[variantTag]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(chain %in% chain_levels_div) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stimulationFigures = factor(stimulationFigures, levels = stim_levels),
      cellType = factor(cellType, levels = c("Tconv", "Treg")),
      chain = factor(chain, levels = chain_levels_div),
      studyGroupLabel = factor(
        dplyr::recode(as.character(studyGroup), !!!studyGroupRecode),
        levels = studyGroup_levels)
    )

  write.csv(
    div_df,
    file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix,
      "inverseSimpson_TregVsTconv_perDonor_", variantTag, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Paired t-test on per-donor (Tconv - Treg) diffs per (stim, chain), pooling
  # study groups (mirrors the reference's chainAnno p-value), BH-adjusted.
  test_results <- pairedDiffTest(div_df, "invSimpson",
      c("stimulationFigures", "chain")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      stimulationFigures = factor(stimulationFigures, levels = stim_levels),
      chain = factor(chain, levels = chain_levels_div)
    )

  cat("\n=== inverseSimpson_TregVsTconv (", variantTag, ") Padj ===\n", sep = "")
  print(test_results)

  # All-stimulation figure (stimulation x chain)
  savePlot(
    plot = make_simpson_plot(div_df, test_results, stim_levels, faceted = TRUE),
    plotDir = plotDir,
    filename = paste0("inverseSimpson_TregVsTconv_faceted_", variantTag),
    height = 7, width = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png")
  )

  # Per-stimulation figures (TRA | TRB, Padj in chain header)
  for (stim in stim_levels) {
    savePlot(
      plot = make_simpson_plot(div_df, test_results, stim, faceted = FALSE),
      plotDir = plotDir,
      filename = paste0("inverseSimpson_TregVsTconv_", stim, "_", variantTag),
      height = 3.5, width = 4.5, units = "in", dpi = 600, formats = c("pdf", "png")
    )
  }
}

rm_tmp(ask = FALSE)
gc()
```
